name: 06807 · Cos Cob, CT
findings: ZIP 06807 (Cos Cob) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06807 (Cos Cob) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
